name: SHOPPER
type: An e-commerce platform for fashion shopping
content: I built a responsive e-commerce experience for men's, women's, and children's clothing to deepen my knowledge of modern web development. The frontend uses React and Tailwind CSS, with a Node.js and MongoDB backend planned for catalogue, cart, and order functionality. The main challenge was creating a flexible structure that could grow with the product.

name: Daresni
type: An e-learning platform for online study
content: For our fourth year at ESI-SBA, we developed an e-learning platform that delivers courses and Arabic-language learning resources. The system uses a microservices architecture with a Next.js frontend and services built with NestJS, Node.js, and Spring Boot. I worked across the frontend and backend, with particular responsibility for the forum and messaging components.
team: Sara Touahri, Nassane Marwa, Yahiaoui Meriem, Bekkhoucha Wafaa, Sidelmrabet Malak

name: ED-GATE
type: A platform for managing final-year study projects
content: In our third year at ESI-SBA, we developed a platform for managing final-year projects, including startup and patent-oriented submissions. I contributed as a front-end developer using React and Tailwind CSS, working with a Node.js and MongoDB backend. Our main challenge was designing a structure that could evolve and scale smoothly.
team: Sara Touahri, Mokadem Adel, Benounene Abderrahmene, Benyamina Yassine, Benayad Mohamed

name: ERP / CRM DZ
type: Enterprise management for the Algerian public sector
content: A modular ERP/CRM platform designed for Algerian public-sector organisations. It brings together contact and contract management, support tickets, configurable business workflows, invoicing with official PDF generation, and real-time analytics. The platform includes JWT-based security, French and Arabic localisation with RTL support, and an on-premise-ready Docker setup.

name: Breast Cancer Detection
content: An interactive Streamlit application that combines biopsy-image analysis with tabular tumour measurements. A ResNet18 model processes images while LightGBM handles 30 numeric features. SHAP waterfall plots and image saliency maps make the predictions easier to interpret, helping users understand which inputs influenced each result.

name: Hybrid Movie Recommender
type: An explainable GNN + LLM recommendation system
content: A knowledge-aware movie recommendation system that combines graph neural networks over a user–movie–genre graph with semantic embeddings from Sentence-BERT. The project includes natural-language explanations, an interactive Streamlit interface, and a knowledge-graph visualisation. Its reported Precision@10 is 26% higher than the individual GNN or LLM baselines.

name: Fraud Lens Copilot
type: An LLM-powered assistant for financial fraud analysis
content: A focused Python prototype that explores how a large language model can support financial fraud analysis. The project frames complex investigation work as an assistant experience, creating a foundation for faster review, clearer explanations, and analyst-friendly workflows.

name: Conditional GANs
type: Class-conditional image synthesis built from scratch
content: A from-scratch PyTorch implementation of conditional generative adversarial networks for CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST. The codebase separates models, data loaders, and utilities for reproducible experimentation, with command-line training and generation, regular checkpoints, Docker support, and a path for quantitative FID evaluation.

name: Advanced Signal Pipeline
type: Signal denoising and source separation with classical and deep methods
content: A comprehensive signal-processing framework that compares wavelet transforms, robust PCA, ICA, and NMF with deep-learning approaches including denoising autoencoders, beta-TCVAEs, and InfoGAN. The pipeline evaluates source separation and reconstruction using SNR, SDR, correlation metrics, and automatically generated visual analyses.

name: Quantum Simulator
type: A quantum simulator built from scratch with medical case studies
content: A quantum-state simulator implemented in Python without a quantum-computing framework. It visualises core concepts such as state evolution and the Bloch sphere, then demonstrates how quantum-inspired techniques can be explored through educational case studies in drug discovery, diagnosis, protein folding, and treatment optimisation.

name: Quantum Algorithms
type: Fundamental quantum algorithms implemented without external simulators
content: A practical implementation of quantum state representation, common gates, Bell states, quantum teleportation, and the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm. Supporting analysis covers entanglement entropy, fidelity, correlations, and measurement distributions, making the project both an implementation exercise and an educational demonstration.

name: DocVision
type: Multimodal information extraction from scientific PDFs
content: A research pipeline for extracting entities and relationships from scientific PDFs containing reports, maps, diagrams, and photographs. DocVision compares text-only and multimodal extraction, then turns the structured results into a queryable RDF knowledge graph so information embedded in both language and visual layout remains accessible.

name: vLLM Research Project
type: Efficient LLM inference, benchmarking, and retrieval-augmented generation
content: A hands-on study of efficient large-language-model serving with vLLM. The notebook explores PagedAttention, throughput and latency across batch sizes, decoding strategies, KV-cache memory, and a compact RAG pipeline using FAISS and sentence embeddings. It is designed to run reproducibly on a Google Colab GPU.

name: Urban Climate ML
type: Next-day temperature forecasting from open climate data
content: A machine-learning notebook that predicts next-day maximum temperatures for London, New York, Tokyo, and Sydney using the open Open-Meteo archive. It applies lag variables, rolling statistics, cyclical time encoding, and chronological validation to avoid leakage, with reported mean absolute error generally between 1.5 and 2.5 degrees Celsius.

name: EcoKG
type: Ontology-driven knowledge graphs from environmental reports
content: An end-to-end environmental knowledge pipeline that ingests ecological reports, extracts ontology-constrained entities and relations with an LLM, and builds a queryable RDF graph. The system uses OWL concepts to guide extraction and evaluates the resulting knowledge against competency questions through an interactive application.

name: EnvIE
type: Domain-specific entity and relation extraction for environmental texts
content: A domain-specific information-extraction system for environmental technical documents. EnvIE identifies nine specialised entity types and fourteen relationship types using rule-based, transformer, and LLM-assisted approaches, visualises the extracted knowledge as a graph, and reports precision, recall, and F1 evaluation metrics.

name: Robotics Fundamentals
type: Three simulations covering core robotics algorithms
content: A collection of three focused robotics simulations: forward and inverse kinematics for a three-degree-of-freedom arm, mobile-robot navigation, and multi-robot coordination. The projects emphasise fundamental geometry, control, planning, and visualisation without hiding the underlying algorithms behind machine-learning abstractions.

name: NexusMind
content: A negotiation-training notebook organised around three cooperating modules: an intent-aware dialogue engine, a strategy agent that models concessions and leverage, and a behavioural coach that detects cognitive biases and provides contextual feedback. The result is a repeatable environment for practising and analysing negotiation decisions.

name: Resilient Supply Chain
content: An agent-based model of a decentralised supply chain with manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and consumers. Autonomous agents move inventory and accumulate profit while stochastic disruptions remove nodes and trigger timed recovery. Batch metrics track stockouts, active disruptions, inventory, and resilience over time.
